scope: Gateway/consumer Azure substrate and stateless Linux bridge teaching draft
source_assertions_note: Text/AST/brace invariants, not HCL/provider/nft grammar or execution
terraform_fmt_init_validate_test: NOT RUN: executable/provider cache absent; no install/download attempted
cloud_init_source_estimate_note: gzip/base64 source length +8192-byte reserve, NOT Terraform-rendered YAML/custom_data
controller_allow_primary: Persistent; explicit close/reconcile/boot required; no automatic TTL
controller_recovery: Best-effort owned closure and persistent uncertainty; no guaranteed rollback/state replication
collector_privacy: Declared outputs/tags/errors are not automatically redacted; CLI filtering is client-side; review private evidence before sharing
controller_finalization: Success snapshot/event is before finalization; subsequent status/health required. Pending removal is last fallible success step. Arbitrary filesystem failure can prevent durable uncertainty marker retention.
initial_observation: First positive and bounded captures only, close both NVAs and review actual tuple/return owner before separately reopening broader controls
